zh: 在一个仓库里，“你取 p、同事取 q”构成一整轮，完整的一轮不改变下一次轮到谁；真正决定胜负的只有最后剩下的那部分 r = (v−1) mod (p+q) + 1（1..p+q）。
在最后这部分里，你第一次出库能取走 p；如果 r > p，你需要同事跳过若干次让你连续出库，最少跳过次数是 ⌈r/p⌉ − 1 = ⌊(r−1)/p⌋。每个仓库的奖励都是 1，所以应该优先拿跳过成本低的仓库。
对每个仓库算 cost = ((v−1) mod (p+q)) / p（整数除法）；把成本升序排序，依次用预算购买，成本超过剩余预算时停止；输出买到的仓库数。注意 p+q 可能超过 32 位范围。
en: At one warehouse, "you take p, the colleague takes q" is one full round, and a full round does not change whose turn comes next; only the final remainder r = (v-1) mod (p+q) + 1 (between 1 and p+q) decides the winner.

In that final part your first dispatch removes p; if r > p you need the colleague to skip so you can dispatch again, and the minimum number of skips is ceil(r/p) - 1 = floor((r-1)/p). Every warehouse is worth 1, so buy the cheapest warehouses in skips first.

For each warehouse compute cost = ((v-1) mod (p+q)) / p with integer division; sort the costs ascending and buy them one by one with the skip budget, stopping when a cost exceeds the remaining budget; print the number bought. Note that p+q can exceed the 32-bit range.

explanationEn:
## Approach

For each warehouse, take the positive remainder after complete rounds, r = (v-1) mod (p+q) + 1; winning it needs floor((r-1)/p) skips. Buy rewards in ascending order of the number of skips needed.

## Proof of correctness

Complete rounds without skips do not change whose turn it is. In the final positive-remainder phase, each extra dispatch of yours requires one skip by the colleague, so the minimum number of extra skips is ceil(r/p) - 1. Skips placed earlier can be exchanged into the final phase without reducing the required number. Every reward is worth 1, so taking the cheapest first achieves the maximum count.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
